why: With 384 wide features and about 40k training rows, kernel and expansion stages can multiply the working set. On a shared training host memory is a cost, so a composite prices peak training heap next to scaled RMSE.
caveats: Peak heap is process heap growth from the jope binary's counting allocator, valid because candidates run one at a time
